FIELDS.NAME: Evergreen Memorial Services
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Officer, Evergreen Memorial Services, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Evergreen Memorial Services, we provide comprehensive funeral and cemetery services that are tailored to honor the lives of loved ones. Our operations include traditional and contemporary funeral services, cremation options, memorial ceremonies, and burial arrangements in well-maintained cemetery grounds. We prioritize compassionate care and professional support throughout the planning process, assisting families with everything from paperwork to personalized memorialization. Our team consists of licensed funeral directors and experienced staff who are committed to maintaining the highest standards of service and compliance with all local and state regulations. Furthermore, we ensure that all necessary licenses are maintained and that our facilities are compliant with health and safety codes to provide peace of mind to our clients. All third-party vendors involved in our services are carefully selected, and we have established contracts to clearly outline responsibilities and liability. Through our commitment to excellence, we strive to create meaningful tributes that celebrate life while respecting the unique wishes of each family we serve.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Evergreen Floral Services, LLC - A full-service floral shop specializing in arrangements for memorials and funerals, ensuring a respectful and compassionate approach to celebrating life events.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a water damage incident occurred due to an unexpected pipe burst in our storage area, resulting in $5,000 in losses. The situation was promptly mitigated, and repairs were completed. Status: Resolved. On 04/10/2023, we faced a minor liability claim totaling $2,500 due to a trip and fall incident in our facility, which has been settled amicably. Status: Settled.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Concrete Grave Vault, Class A, Grade 1
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Security fencing installed around the cemetery perimeter, monitored by on-site watchpersons during operating hours."
